title: Observe European White Flowers isolated read operands
changes: Add a bounded test-only observer for the pre-step operands of two original White Flowers source reads.
validation: Windows build vdeeh6qg and Wine unit s86speyz observe both exact byte and halfword operands in normal interpreter steps over 600 retained frames; Wine server drained.
limitations: Caller ancestry, selector domains, complete asset extents, runtime publication, other scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
